policy: Emerald is the canonical gameplay-parameter baseline for every LeafGreen item.

compatibility.shared_ids: 0..374 are numerically aligned between public pokefirered and pokeemerald sources.
compatibility.localization: Keep each target ROM's native names/descriptions/assets where available.
compatibility.engine_adapter: Translate Emerald semantic pockets/types/callbacks to LeafGreen equivalents; never copy Emerald code pointers or engine enum numbers blindly.
